lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Ellie Bah is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Ellie is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
d41: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead — and presses the tribute down to 3,000 kcal/week while the chair is empty. They'll test the link. Count on it. (Trust -8.)

d41: 🕯️ Ellie's funeral feast: 1,500 kcal from the pantry, and every shaken fire is fed — Emberhold. The village mourns together, and the links hold because the dead are honored, not because the grief was forgotten. (Trust mended — the -8 bought back with grain.)
d41: 🕯️ Ellie Bah is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Ellie kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Ellie's gone." Jorge looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Ellie." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Barbara blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Ellie Bah, 41 days. The mantle passes to Barbara Valencia.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Barbara Valencia, 26 — an emergency dispatcher. Her hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Bird Whisperer, Echo Location.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Ellie — and Ellie is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Jude, Alma, Brunhilde and 4 more speak for Barbara — "Ellie trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Barbara before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.

lastSay: d110: 🍽️ Daniyar watches another basket arrive and laughs. "We're feeding the shelves more than ourselves. Not today."
d111: — DAY 111 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
d111: Overnight, 7 Hickory Nuts (in shell) went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
d111: Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
d111: Dawn. You wake rested. (+0 health, energy restored. Your sleeping body burned less — 14 kcal conserved. By the fire. Good enough.)
